info.title: CampusConnect API
info.description:
REST API for campus events, study groups, announcements and participation, with GitHub OAuth.

**How to log in for testing:** open `/auth/github` in a new browser tab and approve GitHub. You are redirected back here and a session cookie is set; "Try it out" requests then run as that user. Check `GET /auth/status` to confirm.

**Access rules:** all `GET` routes for events, announcements and study groups are public. Every `POST`, `PUT` and `DELETE` requires login (401 otherwise), and `PUT`/`DELETE` also require that you own the record (403 otherwise). Participation routes are always login-only and personal. The owner id (organizer, author, owner, user) is taken from your login, never from the request body.

Errors always return JSON: `{ "error": "message", "details": [...] }`.
